title: My experience of futuristic travel/airpods in dreams
content: I've been dreaming of a place for several years, but my Mallworld is sometimes a mall, sometimes a college dorm, and sometimes a hotel with a restaurant in the lobby. All of these places have elevators, but I am usually wandering down the long halls, past many doors, looking for a stairwell. Sometimes, I crawl through holes in the ceiling, up ladders, etc., to get to my destination/floor. The script always follows the storyline that I am on my way to the airport. I am aware of the city blocks that surround Mallworld, and the way to the airport is always the same: dirty back alleys, leading to high roads held up by stilt-like poles, going almost straight up. Then, the Airport. Sometimes more like a subway terminal. Sometimes a laundromat? The entrances to the "travel pods" are like front loading washing machines. I always anticipate a "squish" feeling (like Harry Potter describes Aparation), and come out in another place. I'm glad to know there are others. These dreams are SO REAL to me. I always wake up feeling like I've come out of a part of another life. Thanks for letting me share.
